records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended March 31, 2023 increased $4.8 million, or 4.1%, to $124.2 million from $119.4 million in the three months ended March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net sales for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2023 was primarily due to higher pricing compared to prior periods, partially offset by a decline in sales volume primarily with the direct ship sales channel.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The change was driven by a decrease in inventory, partially offset by lower cash earnings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Unit sales decreased 13.2% and average unit price increased by 19.9% in the three months ended March 31, 2023 as compared to the same period in the prior fiscal year, resulting in an increase in our net sales of 4.1%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted our financial position, results of operations, cash flows and liquidity as the spread of the pandemic and resulting governmental actions have decreased the demand for our products.
